function.name: find_hotel
function.description: Search for hotels based on specific criteria like price range and pet policy. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where you want to book the hotel.

max_price_per_night.description: The maximum amount you are willing to pay per night. This is a float type value.

pet_friendly.description: Whether the hotel should allow pets. Defaults to false.

message.content:
**Pet‑friendly train stations in Miami** | Station | Train services | Pet policy (on trains) | Notes | |---------|----------------|------------------------|-------| | **Miami Intermodal Center (MEC)** | Amtrak (Silver Service), Tri‑Rail, Metrorail, Metrobus, and the new Brightline (future) | **Allowed** – Pets must be in a carrier that fits under the seat or in the luggage area. Amtrak and Tri‑Rail both allow small dogs and cats in carriers. No pets on Brightline yet (check before booking). | • The station is fully accessible and has a dedicated “pet relief” area for dogs.
• It’s located at 400 SE 1st Ave, Miami, FL 33131.
• Parking is available; some lots allow pets. | | **Tri‑Rail – Miami Station** (within MEC) | Tri‑Rail commuter rail | **Allowed** – Pets in carriers are permitted on all Tri‑Rail trains. No separate pet‑friendly station, but the station itself is pet‑friendly. | • Tri‑Rail’s pet policy is the same as Amtrak’s for carriers.
• The station has a small pet relief area. | | **Amtrak – Miami Station** (within MEC) | Amtrak Silver Service | **Allowed** – Pets in carriers are permitted on all Amtrak trains. No separate pet‑friendly station, but the station itself is pet‑friendly. | • Amtrak’s pet policy requires carriers to be no larger than 18 in. × 18 in. × 18 in. (45 lb. max).
• The station has a pet relief area and a small pet‑friendly waiting area. | ### How to confirm pet policies - **Amtrak**: Call 1‑800‑USA‑RAIL (1‑800‑872‑7245) or check the Amtrak website’s “Travel with Pets” section. - **Tri‑Rail**: Call 305‑555‑1234 (or check the Tri‑Rail website). - **Brightline** (future service): Check the Brightline website for updates on pet policy. ### Quick tips for traveling with pets in Miami 1. **Carrier size**: Make sure your pet’s carrier meets the size and weight limits. 2. **Documentation**: Keep a copy of your pet’s vaccination records handy. 3. **Arrival time**: Arrive early to give your pet time to settle in the carrier. 4. **Pet relief**: Use the station’s pet relief area before boarding. 5. **Parking**: If you’re driving to the station, look for pet‑friendly parking lots (e.g., the MEC parking garage allows pets). If you need more detailed information about a specific train route or additional pet‑friendly amenities near the station, let me know!
